args.title: Fix weekly export schedule skipping its first run
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In `nextRunAt`, the "weekly" case unconditionally adds 7 days to `from`, even when the computed run time (today at RUN_HOUR_UTC) is still ahead of `from`. The "daily" case correctly guards this with `if (next <= from) next.setUTCDate(next.getUTCDate() + 1)`, but "weekly" lacks the equivalent check, so it always jumps a full week ahead regardless of what time of day the schedule was created.

This explains the reported behaviour: a weekly schedule created at 05:40 UTC (before the 06:00 UTC run hour) should have its first run later that same day, but instead skips straight to the following week, so no export is sent on the day it was created.

Proposed fix: change the "weekly" branch to mirror "daily" by only advancing a full week when `next <= from`, e.g.:

```
case "weekly":
  if (next <= from) next.setUTCDate(next.getUTCDate() + 7);
  break;
```

This makes the first weekly run land on the same day when the schedule is created before RUN_HOUR_UTC, and on the correct day otherwise, matching the existing daily/monthly logic.
